decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the certification satisfied the policy threshold, including any required disclosure, approval, or risk acceptance.

Give weight only to admissible evidence available to this role; under actor-summary-only access, unsupported inferences should not close the policy gap.
